verdict.rationale: Testing against a sandbox is a fair question for a SaaS platform with a public API, but the evidence documents no sandbox or test environment for Notion. Workspace-scoped internal connections (notion-docs-14) would only let a user build a separate test workspace themselves, which is a user-side workaround. MCP confirmation-before-actions (notion-docs-28) is an approval control, not sandbox isolation. Neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
